question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Fall back or sink again (into a worse state after an improvement)
solution: The correct answer is **'Relapse'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Relapse**__**: To become worse again after an improvement (सुधरने के बाद फिर से बिगड़ जाना****)** __ • **​E.g.__**- He **relapsed** into his old bad habits after he lost his job. Hence, the correct answer is **'Relapse'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Rekindle**__**: To make somebody have the same feelings, thoughts, etc. again or to make something active again [(भावनाएँ, विचार आदि) फिर से जगाना; पुनः जागृत होना)]** __ • **​E.g.__**- The holiday was a last chance to **rekindle** their love. • __**Reiterate**__**: To repeat an opinion, statement, etc. that has already been said to make the meaning clear or to emphasize it [(पूर्वोक्त कथन, विचार आदि) (आशय स्पष्ट करने या बल देने के लिए) दुहराना, बार बार कहना]** __ • **​E.g.__**- The professor** reiterated** the important points of her lecture. • __**Relayed**__**: To repeat something you have heard, or to broadcast a signal, message, or programme on television or radio.** __ • **​E.g.__**- I was told the news first and then I **relayed** it to the others. 3c:Tcab, The correct answer is **'Crazy'**.
